2.88.15
Chart.ChartLegends
Applies to RDL 2008/01, RDL 2010/01, and RDL 2016/01
The Chart.ChartLegends element specifies the set of chart legends in a Chart. This element is
optional. This element is of type ChartLegends.
Following is the parent element of the Chart.ChartLegends element.
Parent elements
Chart
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Chart.ChartLegends element.
 <xsd:element name="ChartLegends" type="ChartLegendsType" minOccurs="0" />
